name: cidash-monorepo
description: Monorepo Cidash — social gamified fitness tracker (frontend React PWA + backend NestJS).

scripts.predev:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')&&fs.existsSync('backend/.env.example'))fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env');if(!fs.existsSync('frontend/.env')&&fs.existsSync('frontend/.env.example'))fs.copyFileSync('frontend/.env.example','frontend/.env');console.log('
======================================================
  CIDASH DEV SERVER (Ctrl + Klik link di bawah):
  -> Frontend (Web App) : http://localhost:5173
  -> Backend  (REST API): http://localhost:3000
======================================================
');"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
